skills.name: Over Soul
skills.description: Activates Over Soul by possessing a sword. Good effects on allies.  *Skill Resistance +40% (6 sec) *Removes allies' debuffs (4 sec) *Creates a shield over an area (4 sec)

skills.name: Vacuum Buddha Slash
skills.description: Summons Spirit Ally,  and slashes the enemy. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *ATK x 3600% Area Damage  *Negates enemies' regen (5 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Shaman King
abilities.description: Shaman King Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deployment Freeze
abilities.description: Gives a high chance that 1 Ranger on the opposite team will have the time until it can be redeployed frozen for a fixed amount of time when a Ranger with this Ability is deployed. Activates 10 seconds after the battle starts.
